conventions.convention: The kernel and RKHS are real, the ordered training list has length n ≥ 1, λ > 0, and the mean-square objective uses τ = nλ in the coefficient system.
For every symmetric PSD matrix G, a_G = (G + τI)⁻¹y and u_G = Ga_G = y − τa_G; singular and zero G are allowed.
Matrix norms are induced Euclidean operator norms. The Nyström specialization requires full row rank of the leading sketch block; r = 0 is vacuous, λ_(n+1) = 0, and empty blocks have norm zero.
The certificate uses the actual original-system residual r = y − (K + τI)b and controls Kb, whereas the algorithm returns the fitted vector from the Nyström matrix.
The algorithm uses exact real arithmetic, permits sketch width zero and budget zero, tests both actual residuals, and assigns certified status only when both residual norms meet η.

The optional GP comparison assumes AC, zero mean, an actual real RKHS, and independent observation noise with covariance τI; Gaussian range-finder expectations retain Countable Choice and variance-one normalized complex entries.

load_bearing.statement: For symmetric PSD M,N and τ > 0, A = M + τI and B = N + τI are positive definite and invertible, their inverse norms are at most 1/τ, and A⁻¹ − B⁻¹ = A⁻¹(N − M)B⁻¹ with norm at most ‖M − N‖₂/τ².

For the stated real kernel, RKHS, nonempty training list, response y and λ > 0, set τ = nλ and J(f) = n⁻¹Σ_i(y_i − f(x_i))² + λ‖f‖². For any finite real symmetric PSD G, define a_G = (G + τI)⁻¹y and u_G = Ga_G = y − τa_G.

For symmetric PSD K and K̃, n ≥ 1, y ∈ Rⁿ and τ > 0, ‖K − K̃‖₂ ≤ δ implies ‖a_K − a_K̃‖₂ ≤ δ‖y‖₂/τ² and ‖u_K − u_K̃‖₂ ≤ δ‖y‖₂/τ. For the stated Nyström sketch with full-row-rank leading block, δ may be the displayed deterministic spectral residual bound.

Under the stated real PSD kernel and real RKHS hypotheses, with n ≥ 1, λ > 0 and τ = nλ, f₀ = Σ_i a_i k(·,x_i), a = (K + τI)⁻¹y, uniquely minimizes J over the RKHS, and its training evaluation vector is Ka = y − τa.
For symmetric PSD K, n ≥ 1, y ∈ Rⁿ, τ > 0, a = (K + τI)⁻¹y and arbitrary b ∈ Rⁿ, the actual residual r = y − (K + τI)b satisfies ‖b − a‖₂ ≤ ‖r‖₂/τ and ‖Kb − Ka‖₂ ≤ ‖K‖₂‖r‖₂/τ.

seams_checked.note: The scope remark specializes the actual GP/KRR theorem to zero mean, an explicitly assumed real RKHS, σ = √τ, independent noise covariance τI and AC. The resulting training conditional-mean identity agrees with the supplier and is stated almost surely.

The owned definition and minimization theorem use the supplier's real symmetric PSD-kernel predicate and reproducing identities for a given real RKHS. They do not infer canonical RKHS existence without the construction's Countable Choice assumption; the test-prediction example constructs its finite RKHSs explicitly.
